'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
